description: This file defines the RootNode class for tree view structures within the YUI (Yahoo User Interface) library, specifically within the YAHOO.widget namespace. It sets up the RootNode as a specialized Node with minimal customization, primarily returning an empty string for its html representation.

classes.name: YAHOO.widget.RootNode
classes.description: A class representing the root node in a tree structure within YAHOO.widget, extending the generic Node class with custom initialization and minimal html output.

methods.name: getNodeHtml()
methods.description: Returns an empty string, representing the HTML content for this node.
